item.name: Initialize a CO-scoped general file upload

request.name: Initialize a CO-scoped general file upload

description.content: Creates a po_attachments row with purpose=GENERAL, po_change_order_id=:coId, upload_status=INITIATED and returns a presigned S3 PUT URL. The CO must belong to the PO and be in Draft. Storage key uses the CO-scoped key shape (`${entityId}/${poId}/co/${coId}/general/...`).
